_readme: Short Google review quotes. 'paraphrased: true' shows a small 'paraphrased' marker; replace with the reviewer's exact words, then set it to false. Rating and count are a snapshot (update quarterly).

quotes.author: Ian V.
quotes.text: The burger was fantastic, one of the best I've had. Great wine, great bartender.

quotes.author: Giulia A.
quotes.text: A gem and a great neighborhood addition. Get the meatballs, branzino and steak tartare.
